description: A young woman in a denim jacket and jeans springs up out of her seat in a packed football stadium, her face lit up, and cheers. She throws both arms above her head and claps hard while the fans around her get to their feet as well. The shot then widens: first the whole stand is up, then the full stadium under the floodlights at dusk.
